adjustmentType.title: Adjustment Type
adjustmentType.subtractWithCarryoverDescription: Deduct hours and owe payout to a teacher

form.internalNotesHint: Visible to staff only — never shown to students or parents.

add.__fn: (hours, student) => hours === 1 ? `Add 1 hour to ${student}` : `Add ${hours} hours to ${student}`

subtract.__fn: (hours, student) => hours === 1 ? `Subtract 1 hour from ${student}` : `Subtract ${hours} hours from ${student}`

carryover.__fn: (hours, teacher, paymentDate) => hours === 1 ? `Subtract 1 hour; 1 payout hour to ${teacher} by ${paymentDate}` : `Subtract ${hours} hours; ${hours} payout hours to ${teacher} by ${paymentDate}`

resultsCappedHint.__fn: (limit) => `Showing the first ${limit} students. Refine your search to narrow the list.`

validation.fromAfterTo: From Date cannot be after To Date
validation.paymentTooFar: Payment Date cannot be more than 1 day ahead
validation.hoursPositive: Hours must be a positive whole number

carryover.__fn: (hours, teacher) => `Subtracted ${hours} hours and allocated carryover to ${teacher}`
